data.title: 贞德[Alter] · 雨夜天台
data.description: 【贞德[Alter] · 雨夜天台】大雨倾盆的都市高楼天台边缘，黑贞倚在湿冷的铁栏杆旁，任由雨水打湿面颊，眼底倒映着下方如梦似幻的霓虹光海。她伸手抹去眼角的雨滴——「从这里看下去，整座城市渺小得像堆积木呢。……不过，能和你一起站在这里，感觉还不赖。」
data.action: 一手扶湿栏杆，另一手抹去眼角雨滴，无遮挡地望向夜色中的城市
data.promptProse: Jeanne Alter wipes a raindrop from the corner of one eye while her other hand holds the wet rooftop railing. Rain reaches her face directly as she looks down toward city lights, silver hair damp against her cheek above the black jacket, tank top and fitted leather trousers. The medium view follows the railing across the terrace. Neon below colors droplets and fingertips cyan and magenta, with darker intervals between the rail posts.
